conclusion: No functional FUT2 allele: ABH antigens are not secreted into saliva and other body fluids. Common (about one person in five of European ancestry) and not a disease; it changes susceptibility to some infections, norovirus among them.
Only the reduced-activity se385 allele (Se-w, common in East Asia): secretion of ABH antigens is reduced rather than absent.
At least one fully functional FUT2 allele: ABH antigens are secreted. Secretor status is dominant, so one working copy is enough.
FUT2 could not be read from this callset, so secretor status is not stated.
